method: Three alternating current/previous pairs in the existing checkout. Ordinary source-mode physical Desktop, identical observer and viewer; no source, step-budget, quantum, or input-authority override. Simulator main and matching current native binary restored after each previous-source run.
limitations: The first character includes the small CPU observer; the burst disables native profiling. These are paired diagnostics, not unprofiled latency benchmarks.
Shared-host throughput varies in both wall and CPU time. Three pairs do not establish a confidence interval or exact causal speedup.
Signal delivery varies idle boundaries, so whole-interval step totals differ slightly. Native profiling subsets overlap owner time.
The separate cProfile discovery run is excluded: profiling inflated Python loops and produced inconsistent cumulative accounting for outer/native frames.

supervisor.note: Outer watchdog includes image packaging and is no larger than the canonical budget.

profile.method: SIGUSR1 before first send_text; SIGUSR2 at first subsequent complete-offer observation. Interval starts and stops on existing owner boundaries. Signal delivery can add idle boundaries; native counters freeze at stop. Physical trace includes this observer and is a paired diagnostic, not an unprofiled benchmark.
